name: Supabase (BaaS) / React / Vite
description: BaaS paradigm contrast stack: no custom backend — a React 18 + Vite + TypeScript browser client talks directly to Supabase (GoTrue auth via @supabase/supabase-js v2, PostgREST data access) with the public anon key; PostgreSQL Row Level Security is the authorization layer (owner-only policies on the apps table, no anon access); a client-side data layer normalizes every provider response into a stable {ok,data,error,requestId} envelope; SQL migrations plus a static RLS policy auditor are included; RLS runtime behavior and Supabase-local runs are documented as unverified (no Docker daemon in the authoring environment).
requires: Supabase project (hosted or local via Supabase CLI + Docker)
